'''Kath hounds''' were [[Diet/Legends|predatory]] creatures [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Overview==
Kath hounds were about the size of a large [[Dog/Legends|dog]], [[Hair/Legends|fur]]-covered, and each [[Limb/Legends|limb]] ended in four-hoofed digits. They were generally not very hostile, unless provoked. However, when [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was being [[Jedi training/Legends|re-trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], one of the trials that Dantooine's [[Jedi Enclave]] [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|council]] ordered him to complete was to remove a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] taint which had made the kath hounds more violent.

At one point, the kath hounds started attacking the citizens of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and were blamed for numerous crimes, including the theft of a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. There existed multiple expressions mentioning the kath hound, including "runt of a Kath-hound," "son-of-a-Kath-hound" and "Kath-mutt."

Kath hounds made a popular pet for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], including [[Visquis]] and [[Vogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. It is possible that [[Juma juice/Legends|Juma Juice]] could be used to put kath hounds to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]]. Vogga the Hutt's pet kath hounds were knocked out this way.

==Subspecies==
[[File:HornedKathhound.jpg|thumb|right|A horned kath hound.]]
The '''horned kath hound''' was a kath hound breed which was more aggressive and dangerous than the standard hound. They had two tusks and were slightly larger than normal kath hounds. Certain horned kath hounds were born [[Albino/Legends|albino]], and the rare albino specimens were the toughest of all kath hound subspecies, Revan encountered one of these on his exploration on Dantooine.

Domesticated kath hounds, called [[Salky hound/Legends|salkies]], were also popular pets on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
[[File:KathhoundCorellia.png|thumb|280px|A horned kath hound on the streets of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].]]
When [[Darth Malak]] [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|bombarded Dantooine]], the population of the kath hound dwindled, and they became rare and prized as pets and guard animals for the wealthy and privileged. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Battle of Corellia]] led to the bombing of [[Coronet Zoo]], allowing animals such as kath hounds to break loose and roam throughout [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] amidst the fighting.

The derogatory term 'son of a kath hound' was used by [[Hurst]]'s friend [[Gerd]] against his son [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]].

==Behind the scenes==
The kath hound first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. Concept art for the hound gave it small horns scattered throughout the back of the creature.
